method: Out on opening night: did not play in his team's first 2026-27 game and was on that day's official NBA injury report with an injury or illness reason (G League, personal reasons, not with team, rest and suspensions are listed under not_injuries and never applied). games_missed counts his team's games from the opener to the last game he missed while listed with an injury before his first game played. open_ended: still out on the capture date; games already missed plus his team's games until ESPN's estimated return date, or the whole season when reported as such. apply: false when the player is not on the same team in the game's universe (skip_reason).
